spans.s: घट् vi. 1Ā (pp. घटित) 1. To be intently occupied about, to be busy with, to endeavour after, दयितां त्रातुमलं घटस्व Bt.x.40, अंगदेन समं योद्धुमघटिष्ट xv.77, xii.26, xx.24; 2. to reach, to come to; 3. to happen, to be possible, e.g. यथा स्वभावशुद्धस्फटिकस्य रागो न जपासंयोगं विना घटते तथैव नित्यशुद्धादिस्वभावस्य पुरुषस्योपाधिसंयोगं विना दुःखसंयोगो न घटते.With प्र-, 1. to be occupied in, Bt.xxi.17; 2. to commence, Bt.xiv.77.With वि-, 1. to be disunited, to be separated; 2. to be spoiled, to break down, to come to a standstill.With सम्-, to be united.

घट् Caus. (घटयति-ते) 1. to bring together, to unite, अनेन भैमीं घटयिष्यतः Na.i.46, नारीर्घटयितुमलं कामिभिः Sis.ix.87, Bt.xi.11; 2. to bring close to, to put on, घटय जघने कांचीम् Git.G.xii.; 3. to work out, to form, to shape, कथं घटितवानुपलेन चेतः Sr.
, घटय भुजबंधनम् Git.G.x.; 4. to accomplish, to effect, तटस्थः स्वानर्थान् घटयति च मौनं च भजते M.M.i.; 5. to impel, to excite, स्नेहौघो घटयति मां तथापि वक्तुम् Bt.x.73.

घट् (II) vt. or vi. 10U (pp. घटित) 1. To kill, to hurt, to injure; 2. to collect together, to unite, to put together.With उद्-, 1. to open, निरयनगरद्वारमुद्घाटयन्ती Bhartr.i.63; 2. to reveal, to make known.
घट् (III) ??? 10U (pres. घण्टयति-ते) To speak.
घट्ट् (I) vt. 1Ā (pp. घट्टित) 1. To shake, to stir round, e.g. (लताः) नृत्यन्ते वायुघट्टिताः; 2. to touch, to rub, विटजननखघट्टितेव वीणा Mrich.i., Bt.xiv.2; 3. to speak spitefully.

घट्ट् (II) vt. 10U (pp. घट्टित) 1. To shake, to stir; 2. to disturb.With अव-, to open.With परि-, to strike, Sis.ix.64.With वि-, 1. to strike, Sis.i.64; 2. to rub, to rub against, K.S.i.9, Rt.iii.8, Kir.viii.45, Sis.viii.24; 3. to open (as a door).With सम्-, 1. to rub, to rub against, R.vi.73; 2. to strike; 3. to bring together, to gather, to collect.

घट m. 1. A large earthen water-jar, a pitcher, M.viii.319, Yaj.iii.144; 2. the sine Aquarius of the zodiac, otherwise called कुंभ; 3. an elephant’s front-sinus; 4. suspending the breath as a religious exercise; 5. a measure equal to 20 droṇas.
घटा f. 1. Effort, endeavour; 2. a colletion, an assemblage, तदीयमातंगघटाविघट्टितैः Sis.i.64; 3. a troop of elephants assembled for martial purposes; 4. an assembly.
घट्ट m. 1. A Ghaut, a landing place, steps on the side of a river leading to the waters; 2. a toll-station; 3. stirring, moving.
घाट m. The back of the neck.
घाटा f. The back of the neck.
घट-आटोप m. covering for a carriage or any article of furniture.
घट-उद्भव, -ज, -योनि, -संभव m. an epithet of the sage अगस्त्य.
घट-उद्भव, -ज, -योनि, -संभव m. an epithet of the sage अगस्त्य.
घट-उद्भव, -ज, -योनि, -संभव m. an epithet of the sage अगस्त्य.
घट-उद्भव, -ज, -योनि, -संभव m. an epithet of the sage अगस्त्य.
घटोध्नी f. a cow with a full udder, गाः कोटिशः स्पर्शयता घटोघ्नीः R.ii.49.
घट-कर्पर m. 1. the name of a poet; 2. a piece of a broken jar, जीयेय येन कविना यमकैः परेण तस्मैः वहेयमुदकं घटकर्परेण
Ghat.22
घट-कार, -कृत् m. a potter.
घट-कार, -कृत् m. a potter.
घट-ग्रह m. a water-bearer.
घट-दासी f. a procuress. (Cf. कुंभदासी.)
घट-पर्यसन n. the ceremony of performing the obsequies of an apostate while he is yet alive.
घट-भेदनक n. an instrument used in making pots.
घट-राज m. a water-jar of baked clay.
घट-स्थापन n. placing a water-pot as the type of Durgā.
घटक (I) a. (f. का) 1. Exerting one’s self; 2. accomplishing, bringing about, एके सत्पुरुषाः परार्थघटकाः स्वार्थं परित्यज्य ये Bhartr.ii.74; 3. constituting a substantial part.
घटक (II) m. 1. A tree that produces fruit without apparent flowers; 2. a match-maker, an agent who negotiates matrimonial alliances; 3. a genealogist.
घटक (I) a. (f. का) 1. Exerting one’s self; 2. accomplishing, bringing about, एके सत्पुरुषाः परार्थघटकाः स्वार्थं परित्यज्य ये Bhartr.ii.74; 3. constituting a substantial part.
घटन n. 1. Effort, exertion; 2. happening, occurring; 3. accomplishment, effecting, अघटितघटनापटीयसी विभुता Par.P.i.; 4. joining, mixing, bringing together, e.g. त्पतेन तप्तमयसा घटनाय योग्यम्.
घटना f. 1. Effort, exertion; 2. happening, occurring; 3. accomplishment, effecting, अघटितघटनापटीयसी विभुता Par.P.i.; 4. joining, mixing, bringing together, e.g. त्पतेन तप्तमयसा घटनाय योग्यम्.
घट्टना f. 1. Shaking, moving, agitating; 2. nibbing; 3. means of livelihood.
घटिक (I) m. A waterman.
घटिक (II) n. The hip, the posteriors.

घटिका f. 1. A small water-pot, a small vessel of clay, e.g. एष क्रीडति कूपयंत्रघटिकान्यायप्रसक्तो इव वर्जनीयाः; 2. a measure of time equal to 24 minutes, e.g. चतस्रो घटिकाः प्रातररुणोदय उच्यते; 3. a water-pot used in calculating the ghaṭikās of the day.
घटिन् m. The sign Aquarius of the zodiac also called कुंभ.
घटिंधम (I) a. (f. मा) One who blows or sounds into a jar.
घटिंधम (II) m. A potter.
घटिंधम (I) a. (f. मा) One who blows or sounds into a jar.
घटिंधय a. (f. या) One who drinks a pitcherful.
घटिंधय a. (f. या) One who drinks a pitcherful.
घटी f. 1. A small jar; 2. a measure of time equal to 24 minutes; 3. a small vessel used in measuring the time of the days.
घटी-कार m. a potter.
घटी-ग्रह, -ग्राह a. the same as घटग्रह q.v.
घटी-ग्रह, -ग्राह a. the same as घटग्रह q.v.
घटी-यंत्र n. 1. an Indian contrivance for raising water; 2. a contrivance to measure the time of the day. See घटी 3.
घट्ट-कुटी f. a toll-station.

घट्ट-कुटी˚प्रभातन्याय m. the maxim of day-break near a toll-station. This maxim indicates the occurrence of what one studiously tries to avoid. It originates in the attempt of one who, at night, takes an unfrequented road in order to avoid a toll but finds himself near the toll-station at daybreak and has to pay it after all; तदिदं घट्टकुटीप्रभातवृत्तांतमनुवदति Kh.Kh.
घट्ट-जीविन् m. 1. a ferryman; 2. a man of a mixed tribe; (वैश्यायां रजकाज्जातः).
